units.source_text: 两人说完话，就匆忙的骑马走了。

en.t: After the two finished speaking, they hurriedly mounted their horses and left.

units.source_text: 对于遇见的这位貌美如女子的樵夫和他带着三只狗，完全没放在眼里。

en.t: They paid no attention at all to the beautiful woodcutter they had met, who looked like a woman, or to the three dogs he had with him.
